title: Local perfection of the exterior dual determinant pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $M^\vee$ for its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and use sheafified exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Let $n,r\geq0$ and let $f:\bigwedge^n M^\vee\to(\bigwedge^n M)^\vee$ be a morphism whose value on every pair of wedges of sections over any open $W$ is $\det(\varphi_j(a_i))$. Suppose an open $U$ has a sheaf isomorphism $M|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$, the finite free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then for every open $V\subseteq U$, $f(V)$ is bijective on sections.

proof.text: Restrict the finite free trivialization to every V contained in U. Basis coordinates identify the internal dual sections with the ring-linear dual of the sections of M. In each direction the coordinates commute with restriction: a functional is reconstructed as a sheaf morphism by its values on the restricted finite basis.

The increasing-wedge basis identifies the sectionwise exterior powers on the trivializing open with finite free sheaves of rank binomial(r,n). These presheaves are already sheaves: each is a finite power of the structure sheaf under the basis coordinates. The localized site has the same open covers, so restriction of sheafification is this sheaf. This identifies both exterior sheaves and the internal dual exterior sheaf on V with their ring-module counterparts.

The determinant formula identifies f on pure wedges with the ring-module pairingDual; pure wedges span, so the maps agree. The wedge of the dual basis pairs with the corresponding increasing wedge by 1 and all other basis wedges by 0. Hence f carries a basis to its dual basis and is bijective, by exteriorPower.basis_coord and the finite dual basis. This includes n=0, n>r, zero rings, and empty opens.

theorem exterior_dual_pairing_app_bijective (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (f : Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n ⟶
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n))
    (hf : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U))
      (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
      (f.val.app (op U) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
        (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n U φ)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n U a) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦
        (show X.presheaf.obj (op U) from
          (φ j).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (a i))).det)
    (U : X.Opens) (r : ℕ)
    (e : M.over U ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))
    (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U) :
    Function.Bijective (f.val.app (op V))
